responsibility: This is the main implementation file of the AArch64 backend. It owns the bulk of target behavior across option processing, ISA and tuning selection, ABI classification, register allocation and hard-register properties, address legitimacy, instruction costs, scheduling and macro-fusion hooks, prologue/epilogue generation, TLS and code models, vectorization hooks, atomics, stack and security hardening support, builtin plumbing, assembly output, and the final targetm hook table, making it the central operational engine for AArch64 code generation in GCC.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-stem aarch64 files, this is the executable backend implementation that defines target hook behavior and operational code-generation logic. The sibling aarch64.h is the target-definition header, aarch64.md is the RTL machine-description pattern file, and aarch64.opt is the option-specification file.
